mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in GDPC1, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 YoY growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5pp in one month signals a rapidly weakening labor market, which will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 1 month but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is above its 12-month moving average, it signals a healthy supply-side environment that will support positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 12mo MA but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1%, it signals an accommodative monetary policy that will support positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 1% but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When both real estate loans (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) are rising, it signals a strengthening housing market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS and HOUST both rising YoY but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and falling, it signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation and pressure corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4% and falling but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is rising faster than the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS), it signals a negative real interest rate environment that will support positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL rising faster than FEDFUNDS but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is falling and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is rising, it signals a weakening economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO falling and UNRATE rising but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances.
